incentive_fee_definition.authority: Note 3 — Agreements and Related Party Transactions, Q2-2026 10-Q (accession 0001747777-26-000028), plus Part I Item 1 'Investment Advisory Agreement' of the FY2025 10-K (0001747777-26-000012) which carries the full defined term.
incentive_fee_definition.income_component_verbatim: '...subsequent to the Exchange Listing, 100% of the pre-Incentive Fee net investment income in excess of a 1.5% quarterly “hurdle rate,” until the Adviser has received 17.5% of the total pre-Incentive Fee net investment income for that calendar quarter and, for pre-Incentive Fee net investment income in excess of 1.82% quarterly, 17.5% of all remaining pre-Incentive Fee net investment income for that calendar quarter.'
incentive_fee_definition.definition_verbatim: Pre-Incentive Fee net investment income means dividends (including reinvested dividends), interest and fee income accrued by us during the calendar quarter, minus operating expenses for the calendar quarter (including the Management Fee, expenses payable under the Administration Agreement, and any interest expense and dividends paid on any issued and outstanding preferred stock, but excluding the Incentive Fee). Pre-Incentive Fee net investment income includes, in the case of investments with a deferred interest feature (such as original issue discount, debt instruments with pay-in-kind interest (“PIK”) and zero coupon securities), accrued income that we may not have received in cash. The Adviser is not obligated to return the Incentive Fee it receives on PIK interest that is later determined to be uncollectible in cash. Pre-Incentive Fee net investment income does not include any realized capital gains, realized capital losses or unrealized capital appreciation or depreciation.
incentive_fee_definition.pik_language_verbatim: 'Pre-Incentive Fee net investment income includes, in the case of investments with a deferred interest feature (such as original issue discount, debt instruments with pay-in-kind interest (“PIK”) and zero coupon securities), accrued income that we may not have received in cash. The Adviser is not obligated to return the Incentive Fee it receives on PIK interest that is later determined to be uncollectible in cash.'
incentive_fee_definition.does_the_income_hurdle_or_cap_NET_OUT_un: NO. 'Pre-Incentive Fee net investment income does not include any realized capital gains, realized capital losses or unrealized capital appreciation or depreciation.' The income fee is therefore payable in full while NAV falls.
incentive_fee_definition.total_return_lookback: ABSENT. Full-text search of the 10-Q and 10-K finds no total-return hurdle, no three-year lookback, and no cap tied to cumulative net increase in net assets on the income component. Nothing to bind.
incentive_fee_definition.capital_gains_component_verbatim: '...subsequent to the Exchange Listing, 17.5% of cumulative realized capital gains from the Listing Date to the end of each calendar year, less cumulative realized capital losses and unrealized capital depreciation from the Listing Date to the end of each calendar year.' Unrealized depreciation DOES net against the capital-gains component only.
incentive_fee_definition.management_fee_verbatim: 'Following the Exchange Listing, the Management Fee is payable at an annual rate of (x) 1.50% of the Company's average gross assets ... above an asset coverage ratio of 200% ... and (y) 1.00% ... below an asset coverage ratio of 200%.'

fees_actually_charged.source: Note 3 tables 'management fees' and 'incurred performance based incentive fees'; Statements of Operations.

incentive_fee_definition.mechanism_finding: SAME PATTERN AS NMFC. OTF charged $57.4m of INCOME incentive fee for the six months ended 6/30/2026 while NAV per share fell from $17.33 to $16.48 (-4.9%) and the portfolio moved from a premium to a discount to cost. The income fee is struck on a base that INCLUDES $84.8m of accrued non-cash PIK and EXCLUDES the $459.6m of unrealized depreciation. Marginal fee on PIK at the 17.5% rate is ~$14.8m for the half (~$7.4m in Q2 alone, ~25% of the Q2 fee) — SignalOS estimate, not a filed number.
incentive_fee_definition.differs_from_OBDC_detail: IDENTICAL post-listing template: 17.5% income fee, 1.5% quarterly hurdle, 100% catch-up to 1.82% quarterly, 17.5% capital-gains fee net of realized losses and unrealized depreciation, management fee 1.50%/1.00% split at 200% asset coverage. The pre-incentive-fee NII definition is WORD-FOR-WORD the same, including the PIK inclusion and the no-clawback sentence. The ONLY textual difference is that OBDC's version adds a carve-out for purchase premium/discount accretion arising from merger purchase accounting (OBDC absorbed OBDE in Jan-2025); OTF's legacy pre-listing tier (0.90% mgmt fee / 10% incentive) is described for history only and no longer applies.

BUT the controlled sleeve alone is at 204.9% of cost and is carrying the quarter: Revolut Ribbit Holdings, LLC is marked at $233.6m on $75.3m cost (310% of cost) and produced +$56.2m of the +$54.3m controlled-book unrealized gain in Q2. The unrealized gains that held OTF's NAV flat this quarter came from venture equity marks, not from the credit book.
control_strata_fv_over_cost.classification_caveat: NOT directly comparable to OBDC's strata. The SAME shared vehicles land in different strata in the two filings because ownership percentages differ: Fifth Season, LSI Financing LLC and both AAM feeders are NON-CONTROLLED AFFILIATED for OTF but CONTROLLED AFFILIATED for OBDC. Compare the affiliated-combined line, not the control line.

coverage_gaps: Fifth Season Investments LLC unit counts are disclosed as whole integers (12 for OTF, 27 for OBDC), so the per-unit cross-vehicle mark test is resolution-limited to +/-4%; the apparent 3.4% divergence versus OBDC cannot be adjudicated from the filing.
LSI Financing LLC discloses no unit/share count in either filing — only a commitment/par figure — so the cross-vehicle mark can only be tested on FV/par, not per unit.
The 1-5 investment rating table is not reconciled to the non-accrual table; OTF shows $0 in bucket 5 while holding assets marked at 8.7 cents.
No per-share split of realized vs unrealized is given; only the six-month aggregate per-share 'net realized and unrealized gain (loss)' of -0.81.
Quarterly NII per share and quarterly PIK for Q4-2025 are DERIVED by differencing cumulative filed figures, not filed as quarterly lines.
Estimated incentive fee attributable to PIK (~$7.4m in Q2-2026) is a SignalOS marginal-rate computation, not a disclosed figure.

Tax characterization of 2026 distributions (ordinary income vs capital gain vs return of capital) is not determined until year end; only the February 2026 declaration carries the 'sources other than ordinary income' footnote.

Liquidation preferences on PIK preferred equity (e.g. Romulus Intermediate Holdings 1 / PetVet) are not disclosed, so the per-share cross-vehicle test on PIK-accreting preferreds is not valid; only FV/cost can be compared.
